bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 200L
	w = rep(c(0, 1), each = n / 2L)
	y = round(stats::rexp(n, rate = 0.2 * exp(-0.3 * w)), 1) + 0.1
	dead = stats::rbinom(n, 1L, 0.7)
	B = 50L
	rw = lapply(seq_len(B), function(b) { g = stats::rexp(n); n * g / sum(g) })
	list(y = y, dead = dead, w = w, rw = rw, rmst_tau = NULL)
}
